_meta.use: Expected Expo push messages (CONTRACTS §5) for the notify tests and the app routing tests. Names come from personas.json. data.url must be routable by Expo Router.
_meta.more_messages: QA-05b: the §5 types not in `messages` (scheduled pushes from daily-reminder, little things, voice). Kept in their own list because src/features/push/__tests__/links.test.ts (mobile) pins the `messages` case names; qa/app/push-links.test.ts checks both lists, and qa/contract/scheduled-push.test.ts compares the real daily-reminder pushes with the scheduled cases here. title/body are what the server sends today (notifications.json copy, filled). QA-52: `cancel offer` (BE-62 (c), MOB-84) moved here from pending_messages.
_meta.pending_messages: QA-52: §5 types the server sends but the app does not route yet (empty since MOB-84 added cancel_offer and bonded://subscription/offer). qa/functions/push_fixtures_test.ts checks them against the server template; move a case into more_messages when the app knows its type (qa/app/push-links.test.ts then checks its route).
